page: Microsoft Azure D96ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Dadv6 server family. Powered by an AMD processor with x86_64 architecture, this instance features 96 dedicated vCPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The virtual machine runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, ensuring dedicated compute resource allocation without CPU sharing.

A key hardware feature of the D96ads_v6 is its bundled local storage, consisting of 5669 GB of NVMe SSD capacity. This local disk space is complemented by Premium Storage capability, allowing integration with high-performance persistent storage volumes. The instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or integrated GPU hardware.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the D96ads_v6 offers a high density of both compute cores and local NVMe storage within a single general-purpose resource profile. This makes it highly suitable for workloads requiring substantial local scratch space and high-throughput processing without the premium cost of memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated instances. Appropriate workloads include large-scale databases, enterprise applications, data warehousing, and general-purpose backend services that benefit from high vCPU counts and fast local storage.
